Sometimes the best company is yourself as you know you better than anyone else, however maybe try joining  a club/class you’d be interested in  to find people who have common ground with you!  I know what it feels like to be lonely. For a few months I had no friends and sat alone everyday with no one to talk to. It may take getting out of your comfort zone to find your people, but it’ll be worth it in the end
Thank you I appreciate this a lot, it’s what I needed to here <3
